basis: TPS54620 SLVS949F sections 7.3.17/18 and 8.2.2.10; simplified current-mode model. Independent component network with eFuse and polymer branch.
limitations: No slope compensation, parasitic L, capacitor aging, unknown modem capacitance, control-loop mode changes or nonlinear eFuse dynamics.

Nominal transconductance values are not guaranteed process/temperature bounds.
Positive analytical margin does not establish physical stability, burst droop or thermal suitability.
